budget_basis: fixed episodes/updates and common hard caps; actual token/step counts reported, not forced equal
stop: Finish 4 predetermined batches; stop run on replay/nonfinite/identity/network errors and retain artifacts. No extra updates selected by validation results.
estimate_basis: engineering meta-to-summary timestamps only; planning allowance, not measured large-run throughput
validation: same frozen 160-task val per endpoint; configuration/selection owner acceptance before final test
proposal_rationale: Rule shaping is currently executable and cycle-neutral at gamma=1. Learned progress model failed independent baseline/credit checks. This route changes the original study and requires Zqqq/Qiu acceptance.
